FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A27
Wet roads cost ten miles per hour, packed snow halves speed with winter rubber, and ice demands a crawl or a cancelled trip. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint slick-speeds; prereq_hint sec06-F05; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec06-F05, sec06-F08.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]
FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A27
Tires swim near thirty five miles per hour in rain and sooner when worn, so prevention is slowing early while the cure afloat is lifting, straightening and waiting. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint hydroplane; prereq_hint sec06-F08; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec06-F08, sec06-F09.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]
FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A27
Curves want braking finished before entry, because braking inside the bend itself breaks grip and starts the skid. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint curve-brake; prereq_hint sec06-F03; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F03.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]
FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A27
Snow tires and chains serve any snowfall, while studs stay legal only from November fifteenth through April thirtieth. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint winter-rubber; prereq_hint sec06-F06; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F05, sec06-F06.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]
FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A27
Shade freezes earliest and dries latest, bridges ice without earthen insulation, thaw edges slick most, and first hot rains float on risen oil. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint ice-clues; prereq_hint sec06-F07; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec06-F07.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0027]
FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A28
Aggressors earn a calm later call to police, never instant roadside punishment, competition, or weaponized retaliation. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint no-retaliation; prereq_hint sec06-F13; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec06-F13.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]
FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A28
Angry drivers should delay, delegate or taxi the trip, and grant offenders the doubt of fatigue rather than malice. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint self-check; prereq_hint sec06-F13; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec06-F13, sec06-F16.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]
FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A28
Camping the passing lane and tailgating both invite deadly fights, so yield left and keep real gaps. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint provocations; prereq_hint sec06-F14; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec06-F14.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]
FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A28
Horns serve rare light taps only, never greetings, green light blasts, or beam for beam revenge. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint horn-restraint; prereq_hint sec06-F14; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec06-F14, sec06-F15.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]
FACT_ID: sec06-R10 | anchor: A28
Hostile drivers get no eyes and no answers, and pursuers get led to police posts or bright stores rather than home. [A28]
Why it matters: group_hint pursuit; prereq_hint sec06-F16; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec06-F16.
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0028]
